title: Case L — 9 x 14 cube array, line source, non-isothermal

units.temperature: degC (T); K (T_rms); heat fluxes K m/s; concentration fluxes ppm m/s

frame.origin: bottom centre of the windward wall of the 9th row (of 14) of the central column: x = 0 is that wall, y = 0 the centre line of the central column
frame.x: +x streamwise (the wind blows toward +x); row k spans x in [0.12 (k-9), 0.12 (k-9) + 0.06], so the array spans x in [-0.96, 0.66]
frame.y: +y lateral; column centres at y = 0, +-0.12, ... +-0.48 (the array spans y in [-0.51, 0.51])
frame.z: +z up from the model floor; cube tops at z = 0.06; heated floor at z = 0

column_meaning.point_id: the tunnel's own measurement point number
column_meaning.config: configuration key: 'default', Case C centre building '0D'/'1D'/'2D', Case E state 'bc' (before) / 'ac' (after construction)
column_meaning.wind_direction_deg: AIJ wind direction in degrees; 0 is the case's reference direction (see frame)
column_meaning.V: m/s, mean velocity along +y (sign unified: positive toward +y)
column_meaning.campaign: 'wind_tunnel' (model scale) or 'field' (a full-scale observation: Cases F, G, M)
column_meaning.uv: m^2/s^2, Reynolds shear stress <u'v'> as published
column_meaning.uw: m^2/s^2, Reynolds shear stress <u'w'> as published
column_meaning.C: ppm, mean tracer-gas concentration as published (volume fraction x 1e6 of the released gas diluted in air)
column_meaning.c_rms: ppm, rms of the concentration fluctuation
column_meaning.concentration_ratio: C / c0, c0 = q / (U_ref L_ref^2) as the benchmark defines it for the case (manifest cases.<id>.normalisation)
column_meaning.T: degC, mean air temperature as published (Cases J, L)
column_meaning.T_rms: K, rms of the temperature fluctuation
